narrative:
Logan County has 31,426 registered voters, with 54.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 36.8% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 8.9%, a pronounced Republican lean of 28.0 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.2% of registrants.
